versions.changelog: v2: Models are now user-configurable via council-config.json instead of hardcoded. Perspectives (Strategos/Analyticos/Creativos) are defined by role, not by model name. Example config shows how to set up your own models. Better anti-patterns section.
Added security section explaining the skill is sandbox-safe. sessions_spawn is a text-in/text-out primitive, not arbitrary code execution.
Enhanced description, added tags for better discoverability and confidence
Add README with companion skill link, deepseek-v4-pro model
Initial release: Multi-model deliberation for high-stakes decisions
